name: Birch Memorial Clock Tower
scope: The standing Birch Memorial Clock Tower in Ipoh, including the stepped plinth, square panelled shaft, four dark clock faces, open belfry with terracotta figures, smaller open lantern, dome and finial.
era: Standing tower in the documented 2012 exterior configuration

originalReview.notes: The image shows a stepped white square pedestal, painted figure frieze, long pale shaft, four-faced clock stage with dark cornices, open bell and lantern levels, corner figures, pale domed cap and long finial.

review.notes: The exact local Qualla public-domain photograph shows the full exterior. Commons retains the original Wikivoyage uploader record and original owner credit, with the public-domain grant explicitly attributed to that photographer. Other Qualla images require attribution or share-alike and were excluded.
